title: Independent Scientific Admission of the Structural B1.10 Snow Process

scientific_reference.independent_oracle_rule: Compile and execute an exact byte-identity reference copy of B1.10 SWAP/snow.f90 against the candidate for identical process inputs; do not reuse F-PM02 expected output constants as the scientific oracle.

admitted_time_domain.rule: The candidate may expose t0/t1, but scientific admission is limited to exact one-call daily B1.10 semantics with no dt rescaling.

required_reference_cases: normal existing snowpack with sublimation, melt and rain-on-snow retention/drainage
two-call continuation from an explicitly accepted first candidate
required_gates: qualification branch does not modify candidate production source
exact legacy reference fixture SHA256 equals B1.10 pin
candidate versus compiled B1.10 legacy outputs bitwise identical for all admitted reference cases
candidate immutable parameters and forcing remain unchanged
candidate committed input state remains unchanged during evaluation
replay from the same committed state is bitwise exact
one-call interval may start at non-midnight fractional time
zero, negative, subdaily and multiday durations fail closed without candidate-state mutation
snow component mass identity uses unrounded values
melt is classified as internal transfer out of snow storage, not as external whole-system loss
liquid snow storage is contained in total snow storage and is not double counted
explicit_nonclaims: No standalone admission of composed F-KT mass completeness.
No modification of Richards, HeadCalc, F-SI, F-KT, F-MR, coupling or performance policy.
